visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A fixed-angle shot captures a large, modern digital billboard positioned at a street corner in Shinjuku. The billboard's screen is initially blank white, surrounded by the silhouettes of adjacent gray buildings under a bright, overcast sky. White and black text overlays are fixed at the top and bottom of the frame. (2) The digital screen transitions to a bright turquoise background as three animated characters—one white, one light pink, and one light blue—burst through a stylized glass-shattering effect. The characters have round bodies, large expressive eyes, and small limbs, displaying joyful facial expressions. (3) The animated characters perform synchronized waving and bouncing motions on the screen, interacting within their 2D digital environment. The camera remains completely static, focusing on the billboard's display which occupies the center of the vertical frame against the urban background. (4) The animation on the billboard loops through its sequence of the characters appearing and dancing, while the environmental lighting remains consistent and flat. No human passers-by or vehicles are visible in the lower street-level portion of the frame.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track begins with high-energy, upbeat J-Pop music featuring a bright synthesizer melody and a driving electronic beat. A high-pitched female vocal immediately sings a repetitive, rhythmic refrain of 'U-wa-wa', characteristic of the 'Chiikawa' anime theme. The acoustics are clean with a high spectral centroid, indicating a direct digital recording. (2) The music continues into a verse section where the female vocal delivers fast-paced, melodic Japanese lyrics. The rhythmic structure remains bouncy and consistent, with no audible ambient city noise or interference. Short, whimsical synthesized sound effects occasionally punctuate the melodic lines. (3) The vocal returns to the 'U-wa-wa' refrain, maintaining a very high energy and positive emotional arousal. The instrumentation is dense but clean, typical of modern broadcast pop production. The track maintains a constant volume and tempo until the video ends abruptly.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the 'Chiikawa' (吉伊卡哇) event or collaboration occurring at the Cross Shinjuku Vision billboard near the Shinjuku Station East Exit between April 25th and May 11th. The video serves as a digital flyer or highlight of the 3D billboard animation to attract fans and tourists.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video explicitly displays event dates, location, and the 'Chiikawa' brand name for promotional purposes.
